title: VTC — shared automatic vetter-grant definitions
description: Shared types for vtc/vetting/auto-grant/*: the configuration of the community's automatic vetter-grant sweep and the outcome of its last run. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

SweepMinutes.title: SweepMinutes
SweepMinutes.description: Minutes between sweeps: at most every five minutes, at least once a day.

GrantValiditySeconds.title: GrantValiditySeconds
GrantValiditySeconds.description: Validity of a grant the sweep issues, in seconds: between one day and two years, the bounds vtc/vetting/vetters/grant applies to an administrator's grants.

revoked.description: Automatic grants revoked. The sweep revokes only grants it issued.

errors.description: Members the sweep could not decide or act on.

AutoGrantStatus.title: AutoGrantStatus
AutoGrantStatus.description: The effective configuration — defaults filled in — and the last sweep.
